label: Capacitor (Film/Ceramic)
description: Non-polarized film or ceramic capacitor. Can be placed either way.

properties.label: Capacitance
properties.hint: How much charge this capacitor can store — sets which frequencies it blocks or passes in a filter or coupling stage.

properties.label: Voltage Rating
properties.hint: The most voltage this capacitor can safely handle before it fails.

properties.label: Type
properties.hint: The capacitor's construction — mainly affects real-world size and cost, not the simulated behavior here.

properties.label: Tolerance
properties.hint: How close the real capacitor is likely to be to its stated value — a real part is never exact.

over_voltage.message: Capacitor voltage rating exceeded. Use a higher-rated capacitor.
